backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining the backend for a social media app, including data types and logic for posts, comments, user profiles, follows, messaging, notifications, and a friend request system with access control and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three ShortSport video sharing features (shared post navigation, preview card rendering, and postId URL parameter support) to their implementing files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON document containing one- to two-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing component purposes, recent changes, and key functionality across pages, hooks, and editor components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining light and dark mode OKLCH CSS custom properties for the design token system (colors, borders, sidebar, charts).
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell with the page title set to 'Smileup' and a script tag loading the React app entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wraps the app in ThemeProvider, InternetIdentityProvider, and QueryClientProvider, showing a loading spinner during auth initialization, a LandingPage for unauthenticated users, and the full router for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/AvatarPlaceholde: Reusable avatar component that renders a profile picture from an ExternalBlob URL or falls back to a gradient circle with initials, supporting xs through xl sizes and both legacy and new prop naming conventions.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with six icon links (Home, Explore, ShortSport, Messages, Create, Profile), hiding itself on the /shortsport route and showing a dot badge on the Messages icon when conversations exist.
frontend/src/components/CommentsSheet.ts: A bottom sheet component for displaying and submitting comments on a post, supporting both open/onOpenChange and isOpen/onClose prop conventions.
frontend/src/components/editor/AudioPane: An editor panel for managing audio tracks, supporting file upload and microphone recording, with per-track volume control, mute toggle, and removal.
frontend/src/components/editor/DesignPan: A React panel component for editing canvas design properties including aspect ratio, background color/gradient presets, shape overlays, and decorative elements. Provides UI controls that update the shared EditorState via an onUpdate callback.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorCan: A canvas-based rendering component that draws the current video frame, background color, text layers, sticker layers, vignette, glitch, and letterbox effects using the HTML5 Canvas API. Reacts to EditorState changes via a useEffect hook.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorTim: A timeline UI component that displays a ruler, playhead, and draggable clip tracks for scrubbing and managing video/image/blank clips. Supports adding blank clips and removing existing ones while updating total duration.
frontend/src/components/editor/EffectsPa: A panel component for toggling visual motion-graphics effects (confetti, glitch, letterbox, etc.) on the video by updating the effects array in EditorState. Displays active effects as labeled badges.
frontend/src/components/editor/ExportPan: A panel component for exporting and sharing a video clip, providing title/description metadata fields, a video preview, and a download button that creates a blob URL for the source file.
frontend/src/components/editor/FiltersPa: A panel component offering preset filter styles and individual slider controls (brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, vignette, etc.) that update the FilterSettings in EditorState. Includes a reset-to-defaults action.
frontend/src/components/editor/StickersP: A React panel component for adding and managing emoji sticker layers on a video editor, supporting categorized emoji selection, size/rotation/timing controls, and sticker deletion.
frontend/src/components/editor/TextPanel: A React panel component for adding and managing text layers in a video editor, with controls for font, color, size, alignment, animation, bold/italic, and timing.
frontend/src/components/editor/Transitio: A React panel component that displays a library of video transitions and allows applying them between consecutive clips in the editor state.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps all pages with a TopBar, main content outlet, and BottomNav.
frontend/src/components/NotificationsPan: A dropdown panel that lists user notifications (follows, messages) with avatars, timestamps, and click-to-navigate behavior, marking them as read on interaction.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: Displays a single post with author info, media (image/video), like/comment/share/bookmark actions, optimistic like updates, and intersection-observer-based view recording.
A dialog modal that shows a grid of the current user's posts as thumbnails, allowing selection of one to share in a message.
frontend/src/components/ShareModal.tsx: A dialog for sharing a post with selected friends via direct message, showing a friends list with toggle selection and bulk send support.
frontend/src/components/StoriesRow.tsx: A horizontally scrollable row of story avatars using mock data, with an 'Add Story' button for the current user and a story viewer modal on tap.
frontend/src/components/StoryViewerModal: A full-screen modal component for viewing a single story, displaying the user's avatar, name, handle, timestamp, and a progress bar. Closes on Escape key press or backdrop click.
frontend/src/components/TopBar.tsx: A sticky top navigation bar showing the Smileup wordmark, notification bell with unread count, search button, and sign-out option. Hides on the '/shortsport' route and manages a notifications panel dropdown.
frontend/src/components/TrendingProfiles: A horizontally scrollable section displaying trending creator profile cards from mock data, each showing rank, avatar, follower/post counts, and a follow button.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: A card component for displaying a video post with thumbnail, play button, duration badge, like/comment/share/bookmark actions, and a double-tap like animation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider for ICP, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via a React context hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines a collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including user profiles, posts, comments, notifications, messages, and friend requests via the ICP actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS, imports Inter and Syne fonts, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes using OKLCH color values, and adds utility classes for glassmorphism, gold gradients, and scrollbar hiding.
frontend/src/lib/mockData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces (Post, Comment, User, Story, Message, Conversation) and exports static mock data arrays for users, stories, and related entities used for UI development and testing.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Provides utility functions: `cn` for merging Tailwind class names, `formatNumber` for compact number display (K/M), `formatTime` for mm:ss formatting, and `timeAgo` for relative timestamps.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider, mounting it to the root DOM element.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePostPage.tsx: Page component for creating a new post, supporting file upload or URL input for photo/video/GIF/poster media types, with caption input and submission via the `useCreatePost` mutation hook.
frontend/src/pages/EditorPage.tsx: Full-featured video/design editor page that manages editor state (clips, text layers, stickers, audio, filters, effects) and renders a panel-based UI with tools for trimming, filters, effects, stickers, design, and export.
frontend/src/pages/ExplorePage.tsx: Explore page with a debounced search input and tabs for browsing/searching posts or users, fetching data via `useGetAllPosts` and `useSearchUsers` hooks and rendering results with navigation to user profiles.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Displays the main social feed with stories, trending profiles, and a chronologically sorted list of posts. Handles loading skeletons, error states, empty states, and opens a comments sheet on post interaction.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Unauthenticated landing page for Smileup that shows a branded login button using Internet Identity. Includes a tagline, feature highlights, and a footer with attribution.
frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx: Full messaging UI with a conversation list, individual message thread view, friend requests tab, and the ability to send text messages or share posts. Includes unread counts, time formatting, and post-picker modal.
frontend/src/pages/MessageThreadPage.tsx: Thin wrapper page that extracts a principalId route param and renders MessagesPage with that principal pre-selected as the initial conversation.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: User profile page showing avatar, bio, follower/following counts, and a grid of the user's posts. Supports inline profile editing, avatar upload, logout, and opens a comments sheet when a post is tapped.
frontend/src/pages/ShortSportPage.tsx: TikTok-style vertical reel viewer that auto-plays videos, supports mute toggle, like/comment/share actions, and optional auto-scroll to the next reel when a video ends.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfilePage.tsx: React page component that displays a user's profile by principal or handle, showing their posts in a grid with follow/unfollow and friend request actions, plus a comments sheet overlay.
frontend/src/routeTree.ts: Defines all TanStack Router routes for the app (feed, explore, editor, profile, shortsport, create, user profile by principal/handle, messages, message thread) and exports the configured router instance.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters from both standard and hash-based routing, persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based color tokens, typography/container-queries/animate plugins, custom fonts, border radii, and box shadows.
project_state.json: Project state metadata for the Smileup sports social app, tracking existing features (ShortSport sharing via messages, postId URL param support) and a known issue where receivers cannot open a sent ShortSport.
